lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 14 to 15 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with an average lateral distance of approximately 30-40 pixels between line centers, narrowing slightly at the center-most point of the torso curvature.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A vertical bifurcated line is visible in the posterior third of the torso, where two parallel segments merge into a single line towards the dorsal ridge. Subtle Y-shaped topological merging is observed on the 12th and 13th lines (counting from anterior to posterior) in the upper-quadrant.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 3 (counting from the shoulder) terminates abruptly in the mid-torso. The posterior-most lines (14 and 15) exhibit significant discontinuity, appearing as elongated vertical dashes rather than continuous strokes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-7 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb, varying in diameter from 5 to 12 pixels.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-haunch align along a horizontal axis, creating a semi-connected geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct white facial spots: one sub-ocular and one on the lateral muzzle. A broad white crescent-shaped patch is visible on the lower throat. Distinct dark pigmentation 'socks' are present on all four limbs, beginning below the carpal and tarsal joints.
